about: Who may call each arr, acquire, notify and JE backup route. The backend test ApiArrRouteMatrixTests fails when a route is missing here or listed but gone, and calls every admin and user route of the Requests & downloads controllers as a member, an API key and an unknown user; tests/host/run.py runs the same table against real Jellyfin 10.11 and 12 servers. access: anonymous-secret (no Jellyfin sign-in; checked by the instance's shared secret), user (a person: API keys, the empty user id and unknown users get 403), admin (a person with Jellyfin's administrator permission: members, API keys and unknown users get 403), legacy-user / legacy-admin (the older Downloads, Calendar and link routes: signed-in users / administrators; Jellyfin API keys count as administrators there). sample: the path the host suite calls when the route needs parameters.
